basics.name: Alberto Bandini
basics.label: Software Developer
basics.summary: Full-Stack Developer with 7+ years of experience across finance and e-commerce. Specialised in the Microsoft stack, with a track record of modernising legacy systems and leading cross-functional teams. Currently working as Developer Specialist at Moltiply Group on large-scale financial applications for major banking clients.

highlights: Developing backend solutions for large-scale loan and document management platforms, with some of the biggest Italian banks among the clients.
Working primarily with .NET Framework, SQL Server, and Azure DevOps.
Leading the team's onboarding onto a new agentic AI coding framework, driving adoption of AI-assisted development practices.
Operating with high autonomy within a ~10-person team, collaborating closely with external client teams.
Worked on two Finance clients on technologies ranging from VB6 to .NET 8.
Built web apps using Angular in conjunction with .NET APIs.
Tutored new team members, including colleagues from abroad, facilitating communication between Italian and foreign staff.
Led the team on both management coordination with the client and key technical decisions.
Developed several CMS solutions for e-commerce backend management.
Assisted in major technological and business transitions.
Tutored new resources joining the company.
Maintained and operated an anti-fraud platform, working in close contact with client banks' representatives.
Assisted management with the onboarding of a major international bank.
